tasks.label: cmake: configure
tasks.detail: Configure the C++ brain (llvm-mingw preset). On Linux/macOS use `cmake --preset default`.

tasks.label: cmake: build
tasks.detail: Build swarm_brain shared library, tools and C++ tests into build/bin.

tasks.label: cpp: bench matmul
tasks.detail: Compare naive vs blocked f32 vs int8 GEMM throughput on this machine.

tasks.label: python: train tiny cnn
tasks.detail: Train the satellite/drone image-recognition net on synthetic data and export models/*.swm (f32 + int8).

tasks.label: sim: compare strategies
tasks.detail: Run centralized(raw), centralized(preprocessed) and striped strategies with a node failure + recovery.

tasks.label: stress: device sweep
tasks.detail: Check the trained brain against every device profile (RAM fit, est. time/frame, deadline misses).

tasks.label: bench: run standardized battery
tasks.detail: Run every scenarios/*.py preset against the independent-thinkers baseline; scoreboard + reports in out/bench/.

tasks.label: bench: run current preset file
tasks.detail: Run the scenario preset open in the editor (scenarios/*.py) and print the fault event log.

tasks.label: bench: smoke (fast, oracle brain)
tasks.detail: Quick pass over the battery without the trained model or stress section.
